title: Keep run truth separate from progress and history

steps.action: Record a failed run against the current test revision and evidence.
steps.expected_result: The failed head is current and remains visible in history.

steps.action: Record a passing successor that names every current run head.
steps.expected_result: The pass becomes the unique current result without overwriting the failure.

steps.action: Revise the test after a passing run.
steps.expected_result: The earlier pass becomes stale because its test revision pin moved.

steps.action: Mark implementation work done without immutable delivery or test evidence.
steps.expected_result: Progress does not satisfy delivery or quality evidence.

expected_result: Runs identify the exact test revision and source, stale passes stop satisfying coverage, failures remain visible, and progress never substitutes for evidence.
